scope: Development transfer after the Harvest Valley vegetation integration. Three freshly authored layouts from the prepared catalog, same author and reviewer, no independent holdout or engine acceptance. The 300-second target includes authoring, compilation, capture, visual review and repair; infrastructure setup is excluded.

cases.brief: Create a small woodland market beside a wide open meadow. A market stall, barn and well form a clear meeting place. Across the meadow, a shaded camp is connected by a returning walking loop. Keep the center open, use detailed catalog buildings, and layer woodland floor plants beneath irregular tree stands rather than planting repeated shrub circles.
checks: The barn, market and well form a legible meeting place with room to move
The meadow center remains open and contrasts with wooded edges
The camp and market connect through a continuous returning loop
Tree stands and groundcover transition coherently into usable clearings
Major assets and plants look grounded and approaches remain clear

cases.brief: Create a wooded hollow for camping, with an arch on a shoulder about four meters above it. Use no buildings or constructed towers. Two trails climb and return around a central grove. The lower camp should feel enclosed by mixed pines and broadleaf trees while keeping a usable fire circle. Groundcover should follow the woodland, and the arch should be visible from one trail approach.
checks: The camp feels sheltered while its fire circle and entrance remain usable
The arch occupies a visibly higher destination
Two connected trails provide an ascent and return
Groundcover follows mixed woodland with readable gaps and transitions
The arch is visible from the approach and major roots and props look grounded

cases.brief: Create an orchard at the boundary between a meadow and a birch wood. A farmhouse faces the lower arrival court, a barn sits on a terrace three meters higher, and an orderly six-tree orchard has a clear entrance between them. A main path and woodland return connect the yards. Preserve distinct cultivated rows, natural understory and open meadow; use detailed catalog exteriors only.
checks: House and barn anchor distinct lower and upper yards
Six orchard trees retain orderly rows and an obvious entrance
Arrival, orchard and both yards have connected clear approaches
Birch woodland and understory frame a deliberately open meadow
Buildings, roots, props and ground materials look coherent and grounded
